description.value: Grand Chinese Restaurant is a Chinese restaurant on Lougheed Highway in Burnaby, one of two locations operated by the same brand. The menu centres on Sichuan cuisine, Northern Chinese-style dim sum, Shanghai-style xiao long bao made fresh daily, and handcrafted Lanzhou noodles. The restaurant also caters private group events for parties of 10 to 200.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 63m; rack (6 spaces) at 74m; stands (32 spaces, covered) at 78m; stands (2 spaces) at 95m. Total: 42 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record matches the Burnaby location listed on the website (4461 Lougheed Hwy, phone 604-559-9181), confirming this is a legitimate second location of a two-location chain. The website prominently features online ordering, indicating takeout is available. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: Website 'about' text describes the business as 'located in the heart of Yaletown, Vancouver' — this applies to the primary Vancouver location (1233 Hamilton St), not the Burnaby location represented by this OSM record. The Burnaby address and phone are correctly listed as a second location on the same website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The restaurant is a legitimate operating business and a plausible food stop on Lougheed Highway, but no cycling-relevant amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed. A site visit or direct contact would be needed to determine whether it meets the minimum WWC required criteria.
